Once the deals are set and the group is ready to wrap up, S.A.M. surprises them by giving Elaydren all of the schemas that he was storing that they recovered from Garra (all but the three being held by the other players). She seems grateful for this and hands them to a previously unseen aide. As the group leaves S.A.M. appears to linger behind the rest, ostensibly to give Errana, the halfling hostess, a tip. This raises Caelin's suspicions but they aren't able to determine that anything unusual happened and S.A.M. appears to be completely loyal to Cassian. Unbeknownst to the group, he had sent another secret Message, this one to Elaydren.

Before they head down to the sewers and beyond, the group makes a second quick trip to the Bazaar to acquire a bag of holding and 3 Alchemist Fire potions.

docs.title: Slumming It
docs.text:
Having been briefed by Elaydren d'Cannith and outfitted for the task ahead, the group heads out to find the E-213 Valve Cluster somewhere in Dorasharn Tower in the Malleon's Gate district of Lower Dura. Arriving at Dorasharn Tower the group begins to look for the entrance to the sewers but isn't having much luck. They eventually find a staircase that appears to lead downward, maybe to the sewers? Ultimately they discover it leads to a tailor's shop, the sign above the door reads Nibbur's Fine Tailoring.

Nibbur's shop is an oasis of calm in the district. His clothes, though primarily designed for globinoids, are well made and bear a distinctive style - Caelin is even able to pick out some glammerweave amongst some of the nicest outfits on display. They also notice that behind his counter appears to be a large rusted metal door - maybe what they are looking for?

They question Nibbur, first complimenting his goods and Cassian even placing an order for a custom set of clothes, which seems to please him and make him more open. He shares that he doesn't know where the E-213 Valve Cluster is or what is behind the door as he has never had a reason to find out. He gives them permission to try and open the door, as long as they are careful with his goods.

Cassian is able to force the door open; S.A.M., using his lantern, and Cligs, using her darkvision, inspect the room beyond. It appears to be a large room (roughly 150ft diameter) that is filled with water until about 50ft below them. The smell wafting out is vile and makes Nibbur back away - regretting his choice to let them open it. Looking more carefully they determine that the liquid is more sludge than water and that, suspiciously, the walls appear remarkably clean and free of any kind of grime or fungus. Cligs tosses a scrap piece of fabric into the liquid and notices that it begins to sizzle - not a path they want to take!

While examining this room and discussing the outcome, the group hears a loud banging coming down the stairs followed by a massive bugbear shadowing the entrance. He enters the shop and begins yelling, banging on the counter, and demanding his outfit from Nibbur. Nibbur tries to explain to Mandy that they aren't ready yet and signals to the party to intervene. S.A.M. doesn't seem to want to get involved and is ready to leave the goblin to his fate when Nibbur says he might know someone who can help with their issue. Finally they talk to Mandy and are able to convince him to comeback tomorrow, giving Nibbur time to figure out a solution. Grateful for their help, he tells them that there is a goblin merchant named Skakan who operates out of a nearby Rat's Market and finds most of his "treasures" by exploring the sewers - if anyone would know where the Valve Cluster is it would be him.

docs.title: The Rat's Market
docs.text: Following Nibbur's directions they make their way to an open square amidst the tight tunnels of the district. Here they come upon a merchant loudly advertising him goods spread out over several blankets. A crowd is around him. The group approach and attempt to talk to him but he is focused on making sales. Cligs buys a rusty bell in attempt to get Skakan's attention on them and ask about the Valve Cluster. Skakan says he might know where that is - for 100 silver. They try to haggle but aren't successful and end up paying what he asks. He gives them directions.

docs.title: No one will notice the pile of corpses...
docs.text: Following Skakan's directions the group locates a door marked E-213 Valve Cluster and open it. They take a more cautious posture, for a change, and carefully descend into the sewer. They spot an alcove above the landing at the bottom of the stairs and decide to check it out. Caelin does uppies for Cligs who surprises the warforged that was hiding there to ambush them. Glaive strikes at, but misses, Cligs and demands the journal in exchange for their lives. The group chooses violence and in short order is able to eliminate Glaive and the two shifters that were working for him. Luckily for the group, they are able to intercept his Final Messenger. S.A.M. helpfully (?) piles the corpses in the alcove where Glaive was hiding and then attempts to read the Final Messenger. Having never done this before he doesn't know how to navigate using it but is able to determine from it that Glaive was sending his last moments and location to a superior located in the city, named Saber.

docs.title: Let's be more careful
docs.text: Continuing on following the map that Elaydren gave them they are able to navigate the sewers and eventually come upon a circular metal hatch engraved with arcane runes and a similar mithral symbol as to the one that is on the journal. Abandoning their previous caution, Cligs shoots the door with a firebolt - triggering an acid spray trap that hurts her, Caelin, and S.A.M. Eventually Caelin figures out that the symbol on the journal and door match and appear to be made of the same material. They use mage hand to hold the journal up the symbol on the door and it disarms the arcane wards and the door slides open. The group takes time to rest before heading out and Cligs sets an alarm on the doorway.

docs.title: Creepy crawlies
docs.text:
Navigating the steep shaft, it eventually evens out into a sort of tunnel which finally opens into what feels like a massive cavern completely cloaked in darkness. Caelin communes with the local fungi and asks them to sporulate where there is danger. The group see that most of the ground in front of them seems to be covered with mushroom spurt. Cassian tosses a torch out into the area to see what happens and in the immediate area around the torch the mushroom activity dies down.

Exploring the cavern the group sees that the creature being repelled by the fire appears to be a swarm of large hungry looking beetles. They also come upon a trio of large rats that Cligs tosses a ration to which takes their attention. Eventually they come upon one building that appears more intact, clean, and doesn't seem to have any critters near it. Entering this building Caelin is truck with a feeling of familiarity and investigating further is able to determine this is an ancient temple to Onatar, the god of artifice and the forge. Cligs searches the building further and finds a remarkably intact font which is filled with a crystal clear fluid. She takes a drink and is overcome with a feeling of rest - the liquid grants the benefit of a long rest. Caelin also takes a drink and Cassian bottles the remaining dose up for later. S.A.M. shares some interesting views on the Sovereign and the faithful...

docs.title: Poor iron doggos
docs.text:
Continuing to explore the cavern the group eventually comes up another building that seems to be remarkably in good shape. It also appears to be sealed by metal doors. Exploring around the building they do find that it might be possible to get onto the roof. First, Caelin tries to open the door and Cassian tries to alley-oop onto the roof with a boost from S.A.M. - both attempts are unsuccessful. Using the rubble around it they are able to climb onto the roof and find that one section has a hole in it from rocks that fell onto it. Examining the rubble they see that an metal dog was crushed by the falling debris. Clearing some of the debris to examine it they find that a pentagonal rod is sticking out of his head.

While they are investigating this, Caelin notices two pairs of red eyes watching them from the other side of the building - two more iron dogs - that attack the party. They both initially go after Cligs, who is closest to them, but as they get close to her they seem to decide to ignore her and focus on the others. The group tries to find a way to deactivate or at least convince the Iron Defenders that they aren't a threat but they discern that these creatures are bound by ancient commands to protect this foundry and they don't have the skills or knowledge to command them. During the fight Cligs' alarm goes off. Realizing they have no other choice, they eliminate the two defenders and as each is defeated a circular and square rod is ejected from their heads.

docs.title: Fat loots
docs.text:
The party is able to figure out that the three rods are keys and find the corresponding key holes on the wall. Learning their lesson from earlier, they also realize that the keys are trapped and they need to be entered in the correct order or else trigger the trap. They luckily figure out that the keys go in order circle, square, pentagon and the door opens. Between the foundry and the secret vault they recover the following:

  • 1 suit of scale mail, 3 shields, 1 mace, and 1 longsword of mundane quality worth 100 gp total
  • Two magic items they are unclear on:
  • a cleverly-made chain shirt
  • a well-made rapier that has a flame motif down the blade
  • a sack of 100 pre-Galifar silver coins
  • a sack of 100 pre-Galifar gold coins,
  • 4 gold ingots each worth 50 gp,
  • 3 potions of greater healing, 1 potion of fire resistance,
  • an old map that shows a number of cryptic symbols spread throughout what appears to be ancient depictions of the territory now divided between the Mournland and Darguun
  • and the schema they came for.

docs.title: Let's ambush!
docs.text:
After recovering the items from the hidden vault in the Foundry, and with Cligs having warned everyone about her Alarm spell being triggered the group sets themselves up to be the ones doing the ambushing for change. Cligs is on the roof being on lookout while the others hide just inside the doors. They are expecting that Saber will need to use fire as they did to avoid the beetle swarms.

Eventually, instead of seeing a torch coming her way Cligs hears a thunderous crash in the distance that echoes throughout the cavern. A short while later she hears another one and quickly afterwards is able to make out a warforged just as they take aim at her with a crossbow. She is able to dodge the attack and alert her compatriots.

docs.title: Who's this weirdo?
docs.text: Battle ensues but the group also notices that someone seems to be coming up behind the warforged. At first they aren't sure what this person is up to, but they also begin attacking Saber - enemy of my enemy and all that. During the fighting Caelin is able to make out that this person bears the Mark of Marking on their left-hand.

docs.title: Let's end this
docs.text: The group makes an effort to convince Saber to give up but he will only do so in exchange for the schema, so naturally they will need to eliminate him. S.A.M. is able to incapacitate Saber for several rounds while the rest of the group attack him. Eventually they are able to kill Saber and as he dies two things happen. First, the familiar Final Messenger emerges from his chest; being in a vast cavern it has an easier time trying to get away. Caelin makes an attempt to down the Messenger but isn't able to and it unfortunately gets away. Secondly, a black band of metal that had been over Saber's eyes appears to loosen and fall away from his face.

docs.title: Back to the weirdo
docs.text: The elderly human identifies themselves as Cornelius Spindleby, a dragonmarked member of House Cannith South. He thanks them for helping him deal with the warforged who took a book from the library Cornelius Scribes at and he was trying to get it back. Cornelius requests that he recover the book from the body. Cligs won't have any of that and searches the body and put the weird visor, Saber's +1 Longsword, and the book she finds into the Bag of Holding and tells Cornelius they can discuss later when they have verified who he is.

docs.title: A vision in glamerweave
docs.text:
The group decide to immediately return to Elaydren to deliver the items, collect their reward, and get some intel on the newcomer. They send a message to her via a House Sivis telegram station and head for the Broken Anvil. They setup in the backroom and wait for her to arrive. Unlike last time, when she was being very inconspicuous, Elaydren really stands out when she arrives. She is dressed in a floor-length shimmer blue glamerweave gown and is accompanied by two well-built guards in House Cannith livery. They give her the schema and she thanks them for their service and provides them with a House Kundarak Letter of Credit for 1,000gp. Ever the opportunist, Cligs shakes Elaydren down for an additional days stipend of 100gp.

Elaydren's bodyguard is able to confirm that they have seen Cornelius at the Cannith South enclave here in Sharn. She also verifies his Mark of Making is legitimate and that the book he was seeking, Explorations of UnderSharn: An Examination of pre-Galifaran Artifacts by Bonal Geldem, is a legitimate text. She returns the book to Cornelius.

Elaydren tells them to periodically check in at the House Sivis message station in Barmin Tower and she may have more work for them in the future. She offers to identify the properties of any magical items they may have found, they give her the three unknown items they have:

  • The weird black kink visor (Night Visor)
  • She lets them know it's an item that a warforged can attune to be able to have 60 ft of night vision.
  • The well-made chain shirt
  • Will provide an AC bonus equal to the wearer's dexterity modifier, up to +3
  • The rapier with the flame motif and topaz pommel
  • Is a +1 rapier that the wielder can use a command word to cause illusory flames to engulf the damage-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet.

They chat for a for more minutes and then Elaydren goes to leave, she pauses and asks the group if they might be willing to help in an unrelated manner. An acquaintance, Nora ir'Roole's, husband Drevan has gone missing and the Watch is being the Watch - not helpful. Nora has hired a private Investigative to look into the matter but Elaydren is doubtful of his abilities. She tells them that she will arrange for them to meet with Max Murlock, the Investigative, at the Black Dryad tavern in Middle Menthis tomorrow morning. S.A.M. invites Cornelius along to help and he agrees.

docs.title: Surely I can figure this out...
docs.text: Before retiring for the evening Caelin makes another valiant attempt to decipher the original schemas that they recovered from the Old Sharn dig site and uses Bonal's notes to attempt to decipher it. Unfortunately, they are not able to discern much more than previously known that this is an ancient Cannith schema and it is coded in a way that makes it unreadable.

docs.title: What a fraud
docs.text:
The group meets up at the Black Dryad with Cornelius and they wait for Max Murlock to show. He ends up being over an hour late and when he shows up he looks like a wreck and comes to their table and immediately grabs a drink. He gives them the same rundown that Elaydren did:

  • Drevan ir'Roole has gone missing and his wife Nora is distraught.
  • Drevan likes to drink at a Middle Dura tavern called the Half-Pint and pays to get the place to himself to drink and think.
  • Two nights ago he didn't come home.
  • She went to Watch but all they have done is secure the tavern he was drinking in and haven't assigned an Investigative to the case.

Max informs them that he isn't really an investigative, he just "plays" one to impress the ladies. He also has run afoul of the Watch on multiple occasions and can't go anywhere near the actual investigation. He offers them 50 galifars (gp) to take over the investigation but to make sure he gets credit and looks good. Cligs (shock) bullies him into making it 75, which he agrees to and gives them 20gp upfront.

docs.title: On the case
docs.text:
The group heads to Middle Dura and that Half-Pint Tavern, on the way they send a message to their old friend Sergeant Germaine Vilroy to see if she can led a hand. Arriving at the Tavern they see a half-elf man arguing with the Watch guard who is blocking the door, the half-elf storms off. They chase him down and he reveals that he is Kyle, the tavern owner. He confirms some of the information they knew and says that when he left Drevan two nights ago he locked the door on his way our and the noble was alone. He usually leaves the back door unlocked so that Drevan can leave.

They return to the guard with Kyle in tow. Flashing their writ from Germaine they are able to convince the guard to let them in to examine the scene. S.A.M. asks Kyle to do a quick inventory to see if they can determine if anyone else joined him. Investigating the scene they find out the following:

  • Amongst the chairs and table is a large scrap of cloth that shifts in color. It has intricate stitching on the inside and the colors indicate glamerweave.
  • Someone fought hard to rip this cloth and probably damaged the entire garment.
  • What is most striking is the pungent smell of sour perfume and rot.
  • The scrap of cloth contains a maker’s mark for Davani Fine Tailoring, a high end tailor that deals with exclusive clientele in Upper Menthis.
  • No one exited out the front door and there is evidence someone was dragged out the back.
  • Mixed in with the broken shards of glass are pieces of porcelain.
  • Picking through the larger pieces, it appears to be part of a mask with red paint, patterned like a dragonmark.
  • You have seen this pattern on posters around a few parts of the city, mostly concentrated in the Middle and Lower Dura area. A group of performers wears masks with red dragonmark patterns, with sporadic shows in Callestan in Lower Dura.
  • There is a lot of blood splatter and small spots of blood, but no large pools to indicate someone died here.
  • The blood trail leads behind the counter and out the back door.
  • The injured person was still alive afterwards and hurt bad enough that they would need medical attention and healing.

They head out back to continue their investigation and see some additional blood smeared on one of the walls, as well as a person huddled near some crates. They talk to the person, who reveals his name is Bort and, for a small fee, tells them that last night he saw 6 people come out of the bar 5 in robes and one being carried by two of the others wearing fancy clothes. One of the ones in robes was bleeding badly and missing his mask, he told the others he was heading to Clifftop for healing.

As they are about to leave, Bort grabs Caelin's arm having recognized the symbol of Aureon on his armor. He gives him a small obsidian shield-like relic with a red gem in the middle and says that holding it makes him feel strange. Recalling their studies and similar relics they had seen drawings of Caelin identifies this as an icon of a Cult of the Dragon Below, dedicated to Overlord Val Gultesh, the Shaper of Nightmares.

docs.title: Reviewing the options
docs.text:
Knowing that Drevan might still be alive but not having had enough time to wait for Germaine, the group debates their options. They can either:

  • Head to Upper Menthis to find the glammerweave tailor and possibly track the Cultists that way
  • Travel to Clifftop and look for the wounded cultist and persuade them to lead them to the rest of the group
  • Go back to Callestan where they had previously seen the posters and see if they can catch up to the cultists

Ultimately, deciding that time is of the essence, they head down to Callestan to find the theater and, hopefully, the cultists - and Drevan.

docs.title: All the world's a stage
docs.text:
The group makes their way back to Callestan and starts their search at the Bridge, a central plaza that they had previously seen the posters for. They see the posters around but they don't indicate any upcoming shows or where the theater is. They decide to ask a local and, by loosening his lips with some extra rounds at the tavern, he tells them that the troupe usually performs out of the Silvermist Theater.

The Silvermist Theater has signs that it was once a fine establishment, but time has not been kind to it. Inside is a large space that seems even larger without a crowd. It's dimply lit with a central aisle and two smaller side aisles. On the stage they can see that an altar has been placed and an unconscious person is laying on it. A cultist in a fancy robe is holding an obsidian dagger and chanting over the altar, there are four additional cultists circling the altar.

The group attempts to convince the cultists to let Drevan go but the leader doesn't stop chanting and the rest of the cultists move to intercept them. They are ultimately able to use Command to Silence Echo, the lead cultist, and stop the ritual. Dispatching the cultists and their leader they see that as Echo dies his skin melts away and a decaying warforged frame is underneath. A Final Messenger pops out of his chest and, unlike the others they encounter, this one delivers an audible message to them before flying away: “The Shaper of Nightmares will ensure my return and I will have my vengeance in your pain!”

The group recovers 180gp from the cultists, a wand of entangle, and the obsidian dagger with a Khyber dragonshard in the hilt. They rescue Drevan who thanks them profusely and offers a reward if they bring him back to his manor in Upper Northedge.

docs.title: 5 Zarantyr
docs.text:
Having stopped the ritual and saved Drevan, the group is ready wrap up this case - maybe. Drevan offers them a reward for their service and they escort him home to collect and ensure he gets there safely. Upon returning to his manor in Upper Northedge they find that Nora, his wife, is gone. S.A.M. and Caelin do some investigation and it seems like some of her clothing is missing but the servant who saw her leave said she wasn't carrying any luggage but was wearing a traveling cloak.

Having felt they have exhausted their options with Drevan at the moment, they accept their rewards, a letter of recommendation and 250gp, and head out to hunt down Max for more information. They encourage him to seek out Sgt. Germaine Vilroy to take on additional protection for now.

docs.title: Where is Max?
docs.text:
Not knowing where Max lives, or if he has an office, they head back to the Black Dryad to see if he is there or if anyone has seen him. He isn't there when they arrive and questioning people they find out the following:

  • The bartender said he was here drinking for a bit and then left a few hours ago
  • They question a couple at another table and are able to discern that the lady seems to know more about him then she lets on but they aren't able to figure out what.
  • No one knows where he lives or if he has an office.

They decide to see if they can find him by asking the City Watch for his information. S.A.M. approaches a nearby guard and asks about the location of Max Murlock. Coincidentally, the guard tell them that they have recently taken Max into custody. He sends them to the station that has Max, which is the one they know Vilroy works at.

docs.title: Vilory to the Rescue
docs.text:
They head to meet up with Vilroy who tells them that she received their message about the crime and had been looking into it. Apparently Max had already been on their radar and when we indicated we were working with him she went to find him. He was found, somewhat drunk and teary, outside of a Kundarak Bank. They ask her permission to interview him and to recover their fees, which she agrees to.

Max tells them that he had received a message from Nora to meet one of her servants who had her luggage and to meet her at the bank. He did so and waited while she went inside and was gone for a bit. When she came out she said that she had what she needed and was going to flee the city. Max thought he was going with her but she turned him down, paid him for his service, and left him there.

They recovered their fee, and Caelin's new hat, and went about their business. The group agreed to meet up once a week to check for messages at the House Sivis station in Barmin Tower.

docs.title: 6 - 26 Zarantyr
docs.text: During this time span each group member completes some tasks:

docs.title: Caelin:
docs.text:
• Finds a crossbow expert to train them in the hand crossbow, gaining proficiency with that weapon for a cost of 25gp per week.
  • Studies the schema and journal that they had retained from Bonal and is able to learn more about it, discovering that like what they recovered for Elaydren this is part of a larger creation pattern. They are unable to discern what the pattern might be for without more pieces of it.

docs.title: Cligs:
docs.text:
• She heads back to work at the Gray Dragon, earning her daily rate of 5sp per day.
  • She also spends her evenings working on mastering the art of lock picking, breaking a number of lock picks along the way to earning proficiency and costing her 125gp.
  • She also spends 100gp to imbue the obsidian dagger as a +1

docs.title: Cassian:
docs.text:
• Sends a message to his parents updating them on all that has happened since arriving in Sharn.
  • Also goes to Nibbur's shop in Middle Dura to finalize his suit which Nibbur sells to him for $100gp.

docs.title: S.A.M.:
docs.text:
• Modifies Cassian's message to ensure the narrative doesn't worry his parents.
  • Purchases a trumpet and a lyre for 100gp.

docs.title: Cornelius:
docs.text: • Having a new found bloodlust and appreciation for weapons and armor dives headfirst in to the world of House Cannith making and crafts a set of splint armor for themselves.

docs.title: 27 Zarantyr
docs.text:
The group meets up several weeks later for their regular check in at the message station. It's once again raining in Sharn. Approaching the Message Station they notice that the door is hanging open in it's frame, closer inspection shows that the station has been ransacked and the gnome working there appears to have been knocked out.

Examining the station, and talking to Jarina, they are able to uncover the following:

  • They identify a set of warforged footprints on a piece of parchment
  • They see several pairs of clawed footprints in the spilled ink that appear to belong to kobolds
  • There are sling stones scattered about the room
  • A message had come from Lady Elaydren, but Jarina didn't know what it contained.

docs.title: That's a big bird
docs.text:
Heading back outside and trying to make their way to the Cannith enclave to find Elaydren, the group is approached by a giant owl that is carrying a satchel. It circles them for a moment and then drops a scroll case near them. Caelin grabs it, breaks open the unmarked seal and finds the following message:

"The normal means of communication  seems to have been compromised, so I have  sent this special messenger to personally  ﬁnd  you  and  deliver  this  letter.
You served me once before, and now I need your help again. Time is short. I feel  that our enemies have discovered me and  are  closing  in.
Meet  me  at  the  Broken  Anvil  tavern,  where we ﬁrst discussed heirlooms and job  opportunities.  Act  quickly,  for  I  believe  that we are all in terrible danger."

They head out to meet up with Elaydren at the inn.

docs.title: Fancy meeting you here
docs.text:
Heading back to the Broken Anvil once again, they enter to find that it appears there is only one customer. As they walk in the person, dressed in dirty clothes and looking disheveled, raises their hands as if to cast a spell. Pausing as they seem to recognize them, they pull their hood back and it is Elaydren.

She hurries them over and tells them that they have no time to chat. She puts a backpack on the table and tells them that everything they need is in the backpack, including instructions in a letter in the left-hand pocket and to take it and go. As she tries to encourage them to leave, the door bursts open and another agent of the Lord of Blades, this one named Cutlass, enters with 5 kobold goons in tow.

The enemies attempt to make their way to Elaydren but the party positions themselves, mostly, between her and them. They are able to quickly dispatch the kobolds and eventually eliminate Cutlass, also managing to intercept his Final Messenger.

Once they are safe, Elaydren again conveys that time is of the essence and that they must leave immediately before more assassins show up. She doesn't wait for any more questions and leaves. S.A.M. follows her lead and begins to leave, urging the others to leave at once and not delay. They start heading for the Lightning Rail station at Terminus while Cligs investigates the pack and reads the letter.

docs.title: One if by land, two if by sea
docs.text: Reading the letter they realize that they need to head into Darguun to an old Cannith outpost called Rose Quarry, to find the hidden location of a secret Cannith Workshop in the Mournland and schema. Knowing that they need to head to her homeland, Cligs tells the group that they can either take an overland route that would take over a week to get there or they can travel by ship in about 4 days. The group quickly settles on the sea route and makes for the ports at the base of the Sharn cliffs so that they can make their way to Rhukaan Draal on a House Lyrandar galleon.

docs.title: Dragon's Breath ahoy
docs.text:
The group secures passage on the Dragon's Breath, an elemental powered galleon captained by Eltarra d'Lyrandar. They have two rooms with Cornelius, S.A.M., and Cassian in one and Cligs and Caelin in the other. After settling in, some of them decide to talk to some of the other passengers. Cornelius becomes almost immediately seasick and S.A.M. ends up spending most of the voyage tending to him and avoiding the investigative blunders of the rest of the group.

The other passengers include:

  • A pair of gnome traders
  • A Valenar elf who seems particularly aloof
  • A human diplomat from Breland and her assistant.
  • A young gnome
  • Three humans in the livery of House Cannith
  • A human priest of the Sovereign Host
  • A pair of goblin merchants

docs.title: Don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious
docs.text:
Cassian decides that he would like to speak with the group of Cannith workers and find out some information from them and see if they are also looking for the schema. He learns that they are traveling to Korranberg to work on a project but they are otherwise tight lipped about their work. They spend much of their time examining the workings of the elemental galleon. One of the trip catches his attention, because she is watching him, and he decides to talk more directly to her. She introduces herself as Karin d'Cannith and has much of the same story as the others. Cassian decides he needs a cover, so tells her that he is a biologist named Diego Dejoya traveling to find rare flora.

Cligs and Caelin decide to go speak with the pair of goblins, intending to determine if they are Daask agents or not. She uses the same accept she previously used with the group in Callestan, but these don't respond the same. They tell her they are traders, hoping to make their fortune in Darguun. Cligs tells them that her name is Xerox and that Fen (Caelin) is her finance and that they have just finished their honeymoon in Sharn (yep, that makes no sense but whatev). She determines that the main thing that they deal in is weapons and it seems like they've at least sold to Daask but they don't appear to be directly involved with the group.

Later, at dinner, the priest approaches Caelin who they saw talking to the goblins, and wearing an insignia of Aureon, and praises them on preaching to them. He shares that he is heading to Darguun to attempt to spread the faith of the Sovereign among the Darguuls. He seems extra impressed when Cligs, as Xerox, tells them that they are getting married.

docs.title: Burying the hatchet.....maybe
docs.text: The previous day, S.A.M. had given Caelin a note saying that he hadn't been lying to them about anything and that if Caelin wanted to ask him, or accuse him, of anything that they could meet at midnight to discuss. They have their conversation but it doesn't seem to have the positive effect that either might have hoped for.

docs.title: Uh oh
docs.text: Later that day, Caelin decide to have a conversation with the House Cannith trio but disguised as Cornelius, who is also of Cannith South, and see if they can get any more information. They have a conversation with Karin and attempt to get more information from her, instead they raise her suspicions even more by probing too much into her project, which is apparently taboo in House Cannith. Fortunately, none of the trio seems to know Cornelius directly and only by name so they are able avoid further issues with not knowing more about Cornelius.

docs.title: Korranberg
docs.text: Shortly after dinner the ship arrives in Korranberg. There is a three-hour layover while most of the passengers disembark and the crew bring on additional cargo bound for Rhukaan Draaal. A new passenger also boards, a hobgoblin diplomat that the group later learns is named Eral. Their time in port passes uneventfully.

docs.title: Fey-what!?
docs.text: Later that evening, Cassian is alone on the stern of the ship looking at the moonlight on his hands - as one does. He is startled a moment later when a coating of ice flashes over his body. It lasts for a few moments before dissipating. He finds in his hand a marble that he had played with a lot as a child but had become lost at some point. He hears the voice that had been whispering to him throughout his life more clearly and directly than ever say to him: "What is gone is not forgotten. This is but a taste of the power I can give you.....I will see you in your dreams." Cassian spends the rest of the night and much of the next day exploring potential powers, overcome with excitement about finally manifesting magic.

docs.title: Is it a bird? A plane? Definitely a spectral owl.
docs.text:
Having departed Korranberg the previous evening, Caelin is up on deck when they notice something in the sky that appears to be tracking the boat. They go tell Cligs who comes to investigate and the two of them determine that it is some type of owl and it is definitely following them, it also appears to be spectral.

Cligs decides to speak to the captain about this, who seems to indicate that they are aware and it has been following them for some time. She doesn't seem that concerned as she hasn't seen any suspicious vessels following them so is dismissive of Cligs' concern. Cligs does not take this well and in the ensuing conversation the captain believes Cligs has made threats, so when she leaves she has a sailor follow her.

docs.title: S.A.M. has had enough
docs.text: Cligs, instead of going back to her room, goes to speak with S.A.M. and Cassian about what they have seen. S.A.M. is frustrated that Cligs brough the sailor back to their room and put them on the captain's bad side. He goes to the sailor and convinces him to leave and that S.A.M. will take responsibility for Cligs for the remainder of their journey.

docs.title: Skelebones
docs.text:
As the ship pulls in to Kraken Bay for the last leg of the journey they sail into the first poor weather of the trip, a patchy blanket of fog covers most of the Bay. Caelin is alone on deck, except for the crew, when they get an odd feeling coming from the bow. Going to investigate, they uncover a group of skeletons boarding the ship seemingly directly from the water. They are able to alert the rest of the party and the captain as even more skeletons make their way on board.

Eventually Eltarra is able to clear the fog using her dragonmark to aide the party in seeing the enemy and also lends several of her sailors to assist the party in dealing with the threat. The group is able to defeat all of the skeletons and Eltarra promises them a reward for aiding her ship when they arrive in Rhukaan Draal.

docs.title: 1 Olarune
docs.text:
After successfully repelling the skeletons, the group heads to bed. Shortly after falling asleep Cassian begins to dream of a vast dark space and sees a large sack. He goes to investigate and upon opening the sack he is pulled in and begins to fall into a vast wilderness bathed in twilight. As he approaches the ground a castle appears below him and he descends into the courtyard, looking back to the sky it appears that the hole he fell through is now shining moonlight down upon the castle. Cassian makes his way through the courtyard towards a large set of doors at the other end, as he does he passes items that appear to be stacked all over the space. Some it appears are given places of prominence but others are stacked in piles; the items range from mundane toys and articles of clothing to weapons and armor of all sorts.

Upon approaching the doors they open in on their own and Cassian is faced with a large throne room with a single individual sitting on a throne being bathed in light from an opening in the roof above. Kneeling before the figure, he calls out in a deep otherworldly voice and says "Welcome, Cassian, to the Castle of Lost Things." He introduces himself as the Forgotten Prince and tells Cassian that there is great potential in him and he can help unlock that power, if Cassian will help him find things he wants. Cassian agrees and the Prince teaches him a ritual that he can use once per day to send items that he wants to him in Thelanis.

docs.title: Land ho
docs.text:
In the morning, the group awakens and has breakfast. The ship begins to make its way into the port of Rhukaan Draal around mid-morning. Before departing, the group meet with Eltarra once more to receive their reward. She gives them each 50gp and gives S.A.M. a letter of recommendation from House Lyrandar.

Caelin decides to make their own investigations of the city and heads out with the Sovereign Host priest to check in at the local temple and do some digging.

docs.title: The Bloody Market
docs.text: The rest of the group make their way to the Bloody Market, a location similar to the Bazaar in Sharn but also completely different. Cornelius and Cassian make some purchases and the group searches for Failin, asking several of the merchants if they know of him or where he can be found. They are unsuccessful at the first few and start to head towards another when they hear from one of the stands a goblin woman shout "Cligsabethhhhhhhhhhh!" and then she comes running over to the group and grabs Cligs in a deep hug. S.A.M. tells Cligs' mom that they are traveling entertainment group and are passing through. Cligs' me-maw, Chulti, tells them that there is a tavern located just outside the Market that caters to non-goblinoids and that might be a good place to look for their associated, Failin. The group emphatically agrees, and Clig's reluctantly so, to join Chulti and Kenen, Cligs' pa-paw, at their home for dinner that evening.

docs.title: The Clenched Fist
docs.text:
The group makes their way to the tavern that Chulti directed them to, the Clenched Fist, and S.A.M. speaks to the barkeep, Darna, and asks about a room for the evening for the group. She is able to offer them one room and the group pays her for this. S.A.M. then gives her an extra tip and asks about an ex-Orien individual they are supposed to be meeting for business but that they didn't know their name. She directs him to someone sitting alone in a dark corner drinking and says that his name is Failin.

S.A.M. approaches the man, with Cornelius in tow, while Cligs and Cassian go to a table to drink and eavesdrop. S.A.M explains they want to go to Rose Quarry and Failin tells him he can take the group right now for 60gp per person, 40 up front. S.A.M. asks him to push their departure to morning and will add 10gp per person, which Failin agrees to. S.A.M. gives him 50gp to ensure that he shows up at dawn and then leaves and takes up a position outside to watch, Cornelius does the same. After about an hour, Failin leaves the tavern and heads off - neither follows him.

docs.title: Bugbear Business
docs.text:
Shortly thereafter, three large and angry bugbears make their way into the tavern. They approach Darna and demand to know where Failin is. At first she says she doesn't know where he is but that he was here earlier and left. They get handsy and demand to know where Failin is and who he spoke to. Cligs attempts to attack them by casting Phantasmal Force and yelling "Fireball!" Perhaps luckily for her, this doesn't work and the bugbears dismiss her as a tiny goblin idiot. Darna finally says that Failin had spoken with a warforged, an uncommon sight in Darguun, and then left afterwards. Finally, they leave and on their way out spot S.A.M. still waiting across the way.

The trio approach him and ask to know where Failin is, saying that he cheated them in a previous deal out of 50gp. S.A.M. is able to convince them that Failin owes him 1,000gp and has plans to meet him at the tavern tomorrow afternoon. He offers the bugbears 10gp to come and back him up at the meeting and collect their money - they agree.

docs.title: Awkarddddd
docs.text:
The group heads out to meet Cligs' parents for dinner. Chulti is just as happy and open as she was in the market. Kenen seems distant, dismissive, and rude, especially to the two humans. The dinner starts off with the group attempting to embarrass Cligs with tales of their "traveling group" and the wonderful things Cligs can do, but the dinner quickly becomes awkward when Kenan starts talking about how "Darguun for Goblins" and then Chulti brings up it'll be the ten year anniversary soon of Cligs' sister's, Soozi's, death. S.A.M. begins to play a sad tune to avoid having to converse. The parents couldn't afford the magical healing that would have saved her life from House Jorasco and so she died. Chulti seems to have accepted this as the unfortunate way the world works and is trying to honor her daughters memory and support Cligs in her desires to learn. Kenen seems to have turned his anguish into hatred for all non-goblinoids, attending meetings about pushing to expel all the other common races out of their country. He has a special hatred for dragonmarked individuals. Cligs explains her own hatred for the dragonmarked and how the houses do not provide their services for free, but does not out Cornelius. Eventually, Kenen can not stand to be among the group and goes out to his forge to work (and drink). The rest of the dinner passes by awkwardly but without major incident. As they say goodbye, Cligs gives her mother 100gp and insists she keep it safe in case they need it in the future.

Back at the tavern, Cligs drowns her feelings in ale, Cornelius heads to a corner to read, S.A.M. is trying to be supportive in a very S.A.M. like way, and Cassian has snuck up to their room to play with a figurine he bought in the Market. He attempts to use the ritual the Forgotten Prince taught him to send the elvenesque toy to him as an offering. He does the ritual as instructed and when he is done he feels a coldness in his hand and a swirl of frost encircle the figure but nothing else happens, it remains in his hand.

docs.title: 3 Olarune
docs.text:
Dawn arrives as does Caelin and Failin. Before heading out, S.A.M. gives Darna a letter for the bugbears for when they show up later that day. It tells them that he went chasing Failin to Korranberg. Failin guides them to a stone outcropping not far from the tavern and presses his dragonmark to the stone, after he does so his elemental land cart emerges from the stone and you all board.

The first day of travel to Rose Quarry passes by without incident. Failin gives you all the information he knows about the old village, which isn't much:

  • It used be a Cyran village before and during the war but now is in Darguul territory
  • It was a House Cannith processing facility for red marble found there
  • The primary residents were dwarves brough in from the Mror Holds to work the mine
  • It used to provide most of the Cannith marble used across Khorvaire

The first night also passes without incident. Cornelius creates a Homunculus Servant to aid in keeping watch, a mechanical snail he calls Snailor Swift.

docs.title: 4 Olarune
docs.text: Again, the day largely passes by without incident or much new information being learned. Cornelius tries to befriend Failin by showing him his dragonmark but this doesn't seem to have the desired effect. Failin also shares more about his business, which is largely hunting for relics of the Dhakaani Empire and selling them (or knockoffs).

docs.title: 5 Olarune
docs.text:
Cornelius asks Cligs about Cassian's magic, since he was sick for most of the journey to Darguun and didn't know much about it. Cligs shares what she saw and knows about Cassian's magic but more importantly, she shares her concerns that his magic is coming from an evil entity and that likely Cassian will kill them all at some point.

S.A.M. makes further conversation with Failin and convinces the man to give him the names of some House Cannith contacts he has had dealings with in the past.

docs.title: Looks like meats back on the menu...
docs.text:
On the third evening, Cassian attempts the ritual to send items to Thelanis once again, this time trying to send a pretty rock he found. As before, the ritural complets and he feels coldness in his hands and sees a swirl of frost around the rock - but it remains.

The group sets their usual wards: Cligs sets an Alarm spell and Cornelius has Snailor Swift keeping watch. In the middle of the night Snailor tries to wake Cornelius after it spots something by making him feel a wet trail across his face but he remains asleep. Eventually the creature triggers Cligs' spell and she is awoken to the sight of a giant boar. The cloud klaxon also wakes the rest of the group. Cligs attempts to put the boar to sleep so that they can deal with the situation peacefully but Cornelius has other ideas in mind - meaty ideas. The artificer attacks the board as it's under Cligs Sleep influence which interrupts the spell and angers the boar. Eventually, the group has no choice but to finish the animal off.

docs.title: 6 Olarune
docs.text: Having slaughtered the giant boar and harvested it's meat, the group re-sets their wards and heads back to bed. While the other drift off to their dreams, Cassian finds himself back in the throne room of the Forgotten Prince. He acknowledges Cassian's attempts to send him trinkets that he has found and appreciates the thought, but the ritual he taught him is intended for items that he specifically is seeking or that are special, not mundane items. With that, the Prince also gives Cassian a mission to find and send to him an item that he desires. This wasn't revealed to the rest of the group and Cassian didn't share.

docs.title: I think we need a bigger party...
docs.text:
Their remaining travels to Rose Quarry are uneventful and as their sleep was interrupted all of the group decides to use this time for a long rest. As evening begins to fall, they crest a ridge and are surprised when Failin asks them "Were you expecting company?" In the distance laid out before them is the mile long quarry and the nearby village, which strangely seems to be covered in ice despite the fact that it is quite warm. What stands out from here is a bonfire burning in the southern portion of the village and what seems like a large group of people.

The group takes time to make a more careful observation and is able to determine the following:

  • They see 4 tents, the bonfire, and two covered wagons
  • There are sixteen horses tied up nearby
  • There are 7 human shapes, wearing chainmail armor and half-faceplate as well as several skeletons in the camp
  • There is a periodic ringing sound coming from the further north side of the village, it sounds like a pick striking stone or ice.
  • They make out the emblem on the soldier's clothing, a green claw

Checking with Failin, and searching their memories, they know that these soldiers are members of the Order of the Emerald Claw - a former elite unit of knights in the Karrnath military that has since been outlawed and branded as a terrorist organization by Karrn and most other nations. They also know that many members of the organization are also followers of the Blood of Vol, the former state religion of Karrn that focuses on the divinity within each person and advocates for the use of undead.

Failin tells them that with the Emerald Claw involved he will go no further but will wait for them while they do what they need to do. He will give them 24 hours to return to this meeting spot and if they aren't back he will return to Rhukhaan Draal. The group agrees and then sets off to decide how to approach the situation in the village.

docs.title: They put the terror in terrorist
docs.text:
The plan they ultimately decide on is for Cligs and Caelin to scout out the group ahead using stealth and darkvision while S.A.M., Cornelius, and Cassian try to pose as lost adventures asking for help/their services. In their scouting, Caelin is able to determine that at least one of the humans is a Cleric of the Blood of Vol and that their are at least four skeletons, they also discover that what they thought might have been ice before is actually a 12-inch layer of glass that was molten when it covered the village and is responsible for the destruction. Cligs is able to determine that the glass is relatively new, only about 4 years old - which means it likely happened on the Day of Mourning. They both also learn about the patrolling zombie glass dwarves.

Despite this new information, the other group decides to continue on to approach the camp. As they do so, Cligs falls on her ass and alerts the camp to her presence. Two groups from the camp head out, each consisting of 2 soldiers and a skeleton, one to check on the disturbance made by Cligs and one to intercept the group of three coming their way. In the conversation that ensues between the soldiers and Cassian/S.A.M. it becomes clear that the Emerald Claw has no intention of letting them into the village, accepting their help, or in any way working with them. They also make it clear that they want them gone - now. Cassian is able to back them down from immediate violence but not to convince them of anything else, so they all retreat to regroup on a new plan.

docs.title: Taking the long way around
docs.text:
Eventually, the group settles on skirting around the village by following the edge of the quarry and going in from the north side of town. There doesn't immediately seem to be any soldiers as they make their way into town again but they do encounter more glass zombies. Caelin attempts to sneak up on of the groups and accidentally slips on the glass, alerting them to their presence. The zombies turn and take them in, but don't seem to want to attack them. This group of zombies is quickly dealt with. To test a theory, Cligs makes an illusion that taunts another pair of zombies and they immediately attack it, but when Caelin is in their view they attack anyone but them. It seems that Caelin, disguised as a soldier of the Emerald Claw, is able to avoid their detection.

With this new knowledge, Caelin scouts ahead towards the two relatively intact buildings. The first appears to be a large Cannith refinery, indicated as such by their gorgon and anvil symbol etched in the door keystone. The other is a temple of the Sovereign Host. Examining the refinery, they see one zombie that seems to be carting debris from the larger back room to the front two rooms and also hear the conversation of several soldiers. The rest of the group joins up with them and they do attempt to talk to the soldiers down but they won't hear anything of it and immediately attack. The leader of the group orders one of the soldiers to attempt to call for reinforcements while the rest dive into battle. The group successfully prevents the calling of reinforcements as well as defeats the soldiers.

docs.title: Finding the way
docs.text:
Examining the room more carefully now, they notice three large fireplaces in the North, South, and West walls made of red, white, and black stone, respectively. They also see two statues at each of the fireplaces made of the same material. In the center of the room is a large map embossed into the ground that features central Khorvaire pre-Mourning, so it shows: Aundair, Cyre, Karrnath, Thrane, and Breland. Cities, topography, and mines are clearly shown on the map but nothing is labeled. Investigating further, they find on the back of the statues the following text:

  • Red Dragon: “Whitehearth, White Seal, NE 9.”
  • Red Lion: “Tallis, Black Seal, E 4.”
  • White Wolf: “Cabblen Hall, Red Seal, SW 15.”
  • White Falcon: “Blackhearth, Black Seal, SE 12.”
  • Black Knight: “Kronu Hall, White Seal, N 6.”
  • Black Griffon: “Redhearth, Red Seal, SE 7.”

Taking this information and the map before them, Cligs tries to start at the white Cannith seal embedded in the white marble fireplace and walk 9 paces North East. This lands them in the middle of nowhere on the map. Thinking that this was likely intended for humans (actually, she was thinking that these racist humans were trying to hide information from the dwarves who lived here) and realizing that she is smol, she goes another 9 paces and see that a mine is marked. The location of Whitehearth is in a mine in the southerns hills of Cyre, roughly 30 miles east of where they are now. Using this information Cornelius works out the locations of the other locations as well:

  • Whitehearth: southern Cyre, southwest of the former town of Stillborough
  • Cabblen Hall - Southwest of Metrol, Cyre
  • Tallis - Near Sylbaran, southern Eldeen Reaches.
  • Blackhearth - near Baran's Keep, foothills of the Howling Peaks, Breland
  • Kronu Hall - King's Forest near the Brelish border with Zilargo
  • Redhearth - North of Shivairn, present day Valenar

All this information gathered, S.A.M. insists that they destroy this map and the statues to prevent others from accessing it. Cornelius opposes this, because it is a Cannith historical site, but ultimately relents. However, he and Cassian decide not to help and to go investigate the church. S.A.M., Caelin, and Cligs work to remove the statues from their bases and pile them in the center and then S.A.M. uses their massive gong to shatter the the area - making a terrible ruckus but also destroying the statues and most of the map. Separately, Cornelius and Cassian discover and excavate a chalice dedicated to Olladra in the temple.

docs.title: Gimme that blooood!
docs.text: Deciding to head out of town quickly at this point, they head back north. Blocking the road at the edge of town they find a tall, emaciated man, wearing a beautiful hooded robe of black silk embroidered with the Emerald Claw and Blood of Vol insignia. He has deathly white skin, and a thick scar runs from the corner of one gleaming red eye back past a pointed ear. He smiles, flashing sharp fangs. “What have we here?” he hisses and eyes the group with crimson eyes. Caelin immediately throws holy water at him, which Garrow is able to dodge. In the conversation that ensues he makes it clear that they can't win, he commands both the soldiers and the zombies and they are already on their way here. He wants them to surrender but they refuse. Cligs casts Sleep and at first it works; however, Caelin tries the holy water again and while it doesn't immediately seem to have the effect they were going for, it does break Garrow out of the effects of the Sleep. Garrow waves a hand at them and says "enough" and suddenly everyone but Cassian feels like he isn't a threat and is ready to leave. They start to go, Garrow lets them, and Cassian decides not to push the issue and follows his friends.
